notes.title: KOTC V1.05 ChangeLog
notes.content:
+ Smoothed channel point dynamic pricing to reduce volatility
+ Improved/stabilized king speech bubble animation
- Panels now only detect mouse hover when the game window is in focus
+ Set application target framerate to 60fps
- Fixed bug causing text number to move very slowly from the king based on framerate

tags.balance_change: + Smoothed channel point dynamic pricing to reduce volatility

tags.feature: - Panels now only detect mouse hover when the game window is in focus

tags.bug: - Fixed bug causing text number to move very slowly from the king based on framerate

notes.title: KOTC V1.04 ChangeLog
notes.content:
- BugFix: Fixed incorrect players sometimes being assigned to the throne after a capture
- BugFix: Gold earned by the king is now properly saved to player data
- BugFix: Cheer Events > 100 bits correctly spawn multiplier capsule 
- BugFix: Cheer Events < 100 bits correctly spawn individual bits from pipe
- BugFix: King capture and falling animations no longer use incorrect player pfps sometimes
+ Added 1440p resolution option in graphics settings (2560x1440)
+ Added desktop channel icon
+ Improved contrast on king speech bubble for easier reading
+ Channel points costs now auto adjust to desired spawns/attacks per minute
+ Added chat bot message when channel point costs are updated
